name: GitHub Secure Open Source Fund
description: Provides funding to support security work in open source projects. Accepts direct applications from maintainers.
eligibility_notes: Open to open source projects that improve software security. Direct application process.

name: Spotify FOSS Fund
description: Spotify's annual open source fund that distributes €100,000/year across projects used internally by Spotify engineers.
eligibility_notes: Nominated by Spotify employees. Not a direct application — best approached by building visibility with Spotify engineers.

name: Microsoft FOSS Fund
description: Microsoft's quarterly open source fund distributing ~$12,500/quarter to projects used by Microsoft teams.
eligibility_notes: Nominated by Microsoft employees. Similar to Spotify — builds through internal visibility.

name: Alpha-Omega
description: An associated project of the Open Source Security Foundation (OpenSSF) focused on protecting critical open source software. Distributes $20M+ across the ecosystem.
eligibility_notes: Works via partner organizations and project nominations. Typically engages with critical infrastructure projects. Not a solo application process.

name: FLOSS/fund (Zerodha)
description: Zerodha's $1M/year fund for free/libre and open source software. Any country. Accepts funding.json manifests or open directory submissions.
eligibility_notes: Submit a funding.json manifest or list your project in their open directory. Global — no geographic restrictions.

name: Sovereign Tech Fund
description: German government-backed fund for critical digital infrastructure. Provides grants for open source projects that are essential to the digital commons.
eligibility_notes: Periodic open calls. Focus on projects critical to digital sovereignty and infrastructure.

name: Prototype Fund (Germany)
description: German public fund supporting innovative FOSS projects by solo developers and small teams. Runs twice yearly.
eligibility_notes: Open call twice yearly. Targets individual developers and small teams with innovative open source prototypes.

name: NLnet Foundation
description: European foundation funding internet, privacy, and digital rights technology projects. Significant grants available.
eligibility_notes: Periodic calls for proposals. Focus on internet-related technologies, privacy, and digital rights.

name: Python Software Foundation Grants
description: Grants for projects that benefit the Python ecosystem. Rolling applications accepted.
eligibility_notes: Rolling application process. Must benefit the Python community or ecosystem.

name: Ruby Together / Ruby Infrastructure
description: Sponsorship and grant-based funding for Ruby infrastructure projects like Bundler and RubyGems.
eligibility_notes: Funds critical Ruby ecosystem infrastructure. Direct application or partnership.

name: Chan Zuckerberg Initiative — Essential OSS for Science
description: Grants for open source software essential to scientific research.
eligibility_notes: Periodic open calls. Focus on open source tools that are essential to scientific research and discovery.

name: Sloan Foundation — Better Software for Science
description: Grants supporting open source software that improves scientific research infrastructure.
eligibility_notes: Open calls / Letters of Inquiry. Supports software that advances scientific research.

name: NSF POSE / Safe-OSE
description: US government grants for sustainable open source ecosystems. Formal proposal process.
eligibility_notes: US government formal proposal process. Focus on building sustainable open source ecosystems.

name: Open Technology Fund
description: Grants for internet freedom and anti-censorship open source tools.
eligibility_notes: Periodic open calls. Focus on tools that promote internet freedom and resist censorship.

name: NumFOCUS
description: Non-profit supporting scientific computing open source. Fiscal sponsorship and grants for scientific software projects.
eligibility_notes: Periodic calls for proposals. Must be related to scientific computing.

name: OpenSSF Grants
description: The Open Source Security Foundation's grant program for security-focused open source projects.
eligibility_notes: Periodic open calls. Same organization whose criticality scoring methodology powers this app.

name: Google Summer of Code
description: Global program funding contributors to work on open source projects. Funds the contributor, not the project directly.
eligibility_notes: Different model — funds a contributor to work on your project. Mentoring orgs apply, contributors apply separately.

name: Season of Docs
description: Google program pairing technical writers with open source projects to improve documentation.
eligibility_notes: Open call, narrow scope. Projects must be ready to host a technical writer.
